attacks.name: Psionic Bolt
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Mind Possession
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Flesh Manipulation
steps: |!wild| |*Explosive Force|: After this attack is resolved, Push each other character within |!range| 2 of this character Away |!range_small|. Pushed characters suffer one |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Biokinesis
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. It gains the |§root§Root| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Psychic Distraction
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| rolled. If this superpower deals at least 1 |!damage|, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Deflection
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. This character does not suffer damage from this collision.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Cloak
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.|\|Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
